newsitem.title: USA: nVIEW sees lower Q1 sales, narrower loss.
newsitem.headline: nVIEW sees lower Q1 sales, narrower loss.

text.p: nView Corp said on Tuesday that preliminary results for the first quarter of 1997 indicated lower sales and a net loss, although the loss is expected to be narrower than that reported for the same quarter a year ago.
The company said it expected to report sales of about $7.3 million, compared to $7.5 million in the first quarter of 1996.

Full financial results will be released on or about April 17, and will report a quarterly loss that still represents "a significant improvement" on the $1.1 million loss, or $0.22 per share, reported for the first quarter of 1996, nVIEW said.

The company attributed the sales decline to lower volumes shipped to international customers and to Polaroid Corp. nVIEW makes visual display products, using electronic imaging technology to project and display images from computer and video sources.
nVIEW shares were trading down 3/8 to 2-1/4 early Wednesday, which is below their 52-week low of 2-5/8. The 52-week high was 10-1/8.
